@@ -87,6 +77,21 @@ Protocol (IDE_KM), provisioning the Root Port is a platform-specific operation.
 This operation is delegated to the Root Domain Security Manager (RDSM), which
 the TSM accesses via the `COVT` SBI's PCIe Root Port IDE management functions.
 
+===== PCIe Root Port IDE Extended Capability
+
+Since the PCIe configuration space occupies exactly one 4KB page and MPT access
+controls operate at page granularity, the RDSM (as the platform security
+enforcer) must retain exclusive ownership of the entire configuration space for
+all RPs. Consequently, it enforces that Supervisor Domain Managers configure the
+IDE Extended Capability for their owned streams via the `COVT`
+SBI `sbi_covt_program_rp_ide_stream` function.
+
+When requested to establish a xref:device-connection[connection] with a TEE-IO
+capable device, the TSM receives the IDE Extended Capability configuration for
+the allocated IDE stream from the Host Supervisor Domain. After successfully
+establishing the connection, it configures the IDE stream capabilities via the
+`sbi_covt_program_rp_ide_cap` SBI function.
+

+The `ide_stream_desc` IDE stream descriptor must be structured as follows:
+
+[#table_sbi_covt_rp_ide_stream_desc]
+.CoVE IDE Stream Descriptor
+[options=header]
+|===
+| *Byte Offset*         | *Field*          | *Size (bytes)* | *Description*
+| 00h                   | Stream_ID        | 1              | IDE selective stream ID
+| 01h                   | Num_Addr_Assoc   | 1              | Number of IDE Address Association Register blocks.
+                                                              `Num_Addr_Assoc` must not be greater than the corresponding
+                                                              value programmed in the `device_id` PCIe Selective IDE Stream Capability Register.
+| 02h                   | Reserved         | 2              | Must be 0
+| 04h                   | RID_Assoc_1      | 4              | RID Association Register 1 (See <<PCIE>>)
+| 08h                   | RID_Assoc_2      | 4              | RID Association Register 2 (See <<PCIE>>)
+| 0Ch                   | ADDR_0_Assoc_1   | 4              | Address Association Register 1 for block 0 (See <<PCIE>>)
+| 10h                   | ADDR_0_Assoc_2   | 4              | Address Association Register 2 for block 0 (See <<PCIE>>)
+| 14h                   | ADDR_0_Assoc_3   | 4              | Address Association Register 3 for block 0 (See <<PCIE>>)
+| ...                   | ...              | 4              | ...
+| 0Ch + ((N - 1) * 0Ch) | ADDR_N-1_Assoc_1 | 4              | Address Association Register 1 for block Num_Addr_Assoc - 1 (See <<PCIE>>)
+| 10h + ((N - 1) * 0Ch) | ADDR_N-1_Assoc_2 | 4              | Address Association Register 2 for block Num_Addr_Assoc - 1 (See <<PCIE>>)
+| 14h + ((N - 1) * 0Ch) | ADDR_N-1_Assoc_3 | 4              | Address Association Register 3 for block Num_Addr_Assoc - 1 (See <<PCIE>>)
+|===
